requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个按钮触发的数据采样系统，使用按钮 D2、光敏电阻 A0、LM35（A1）和串口。按下按钮后立即采集一次光照与温度数据并通过串口输出，同时将采样计数加一；每完成 5 次采样，让蜂鸣器 D6 短鸣一次提示。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Hold io_0 false initially; then create a single rising edge on io_0 (false->true) with stable io_1 and io_2; keep io_0 true for one step then release to false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On the step of the rising edge, serial_0_trigger==true and serial_0_value_0==io_1 (sampled), serial_0_value_1==io_2 (sampled), serial_0_value_2==1; io_3==0 unless sampleCount is a multiple of 5 at that step.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 实现一个按钮触发的数据采样系统，使用按钮 D2、光敏电阻 A0、LM35（A1）和串口。按下按钮后立即采集一次光照与温度数据并通过串口输出，同时将采样计数加一；每完成 5 次采样，让蜂鸣器 D6 短鸣一次提示。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Generate 5 separate button press rising edges (io_0 false->true each time with at least one intervening false step). Keep io_1 and io_2 constant across all steps, so only the sample counter changes.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger is true exactly on each press rising-edge step; serial_0_value_2 equals the incremented count (1..5) on those steps; io_3 is nonzero only on the 5th sampling step (when count becomes 5) and 0 on the other four sampling steps.
